name: OpenAI readers on matched rebuilt-retrieval evidence
status: Exploratory extension on previously inspected questions; not a fresh holdout
execution: Responses API, no tools, no conversation history, store=false, truncation disabled, standard service tier; dev before test; one recorded response per unique full request reused across identical cases
comparison: Reuse the exact 400 cases and original prompt/decoder/scorer from the matched FLAN-T5 follow-up. Report every arm, split, retrieval view and variant. No post-development selection.
limitations: 50 reused source questions: 15 development and 35 test; no independent evaluation or financial review
Two configurations from one OpenAI family, compared with the existing FLAN-T5 family; parameter counts are not established
Prepared statement text and restricted row parser; no raw-PDF or iXBRL intervention
API outputs may vary even at temperature zero; snapshot identifiers and response records do not make hosted inference bitwise reproducible
Identical-input response reuse makes agreement structural; this is not a stochastic repeatability study
The 32-token output budget and no-reasoning setting test a matched short-answer interface, not maximum model capability
Input ceiling uses UTF-8 bytes rather than the FLAN tokenizer; actual API token usage is retained
Local cost accounting is an estimate based on published rates, not a provider-enforced billing cap
